description:
A mass hiring process for a financial company requires balancing speed and volume with strict regulatory compliance, risk management, and candidate quality.
It begins with strategic planning to define standardized job profiles, set target metrics, and assign dedicated recruitment teams.
Sourcing relies heavily on programmatic advertising, career fairs, and simplified mobile application forms to generate large candidate pools quickly.
To manage high applicant volume efficiently, initial screening is automated using applicant tracking systems for knockout questions, online skill and situational judgment tests, and asynchronous video interviews.
Promising candidates then move through accelerated selection events, such as speed interviews or group assessment centers, where managers use standardized rubrics to make fast hiring decisions.
Once conditional offers are issued, candidates undergo rigorous financial background checks, including credit, criminal, and AML sanction screenings.
Finally, the process concludes with automated digital offer letters and batch onboarding cohorts to streamline training and maintain candidate engagement prior to their start date.
